**Application Process:**
1. Submit Form HR-301 (Educational Assistance Request) 30 days prior to course start
2. Obtain approval from direct manager and Learning & Development team
3. Maintain minimum grade of "B" (or equivalent) for reimbursement eligibility
4. Submit reimbursement request with official transcripts within 60 days of course completion

### 5.2 Internal Training and Development

### 3.3 Submission Deadlines

- **Monthly Expenses:** Submit by the 5th of the following month
- **Travel-Related Expenses:** Submit within 10 business days of trip completion
- **Annual Deadline:** All expenses must be submitted by December 20th for current fiscal year processing

## 4. APPROVAL WORKFLOW

### 4.1 Standard Approval Process

### 6.2 Training and Support
All employees must complete the "Professional Communication Excellence" module within 30 days of employment and annually thereafter. Additional support resources are available through the Learning Management System at learn.techventure.com.

## 7. Policy Violations and Enforcement

**Eligibility Criteria:**
- Minimum 12 months of employment
- Satisfactory performance rating
- Course relevance to current role or career advancement within company

**Reimbursement Structure:**
- Undergraduate coursework: Up to $3,000 per calendar year
- Graduate coursework: Up to $5,000 per calendar year
- Professional certifications: Up to $2,000 per calendar year

### 7.3 Training Requirements
All personnel must complete:
- Initial data classification training within 30 days of hire
- Annual refresher training and certification
- Role-specific advanced training for data custodians
- Incident response and breach notification procedures

## 8. POLICY REVIEW AND UPDATES

**Step 2: Resource Request Submission**
- Complete Form RA-002 for all resource requests
- Submit requests minimum 30 days before required start date
- Include justification for specialized skill requirements
- Obtain department head pre-approval for requests exceeding 0.5 FTE

## 6. COMPLIANCE AND ENFORCEMENT

Violations of this Acceptable Use Policy may result in disciplinary action ranging from verbal warnings to termination of employment, depending on severity and frequency. All employees must acknowledge receipt and understanding of this policy by completing the online training module in the Learning Management System within 30 days of hire or policy updates.
